passageOverrides.before: Check the T2 census on scratch trees: the walker uses no more objects and edges than the census cost model predicts on every walk vector and composed-workspace vector; the census pins the cost closure as compiled; each censused entry is classified against the discovery profile limits by charging a fresh ledger, and no margin is claimed for a failing entry.
passageOverrides.after: Check the T2 census on scratch trees: the walker uses no more objects and edges than the census cost model predicts on every walk vector and composed-workspace vector; the census pins the cost closure and size inventory as compiled; each censused entry is classified against the discovery profile limits in objects, edges and bytes at the largest root length by charging a fresh ledger, and no lead-readable entry fails; composed held-out rows are classified by their blind margins, with coverage and the held-out state checked, and only a holding state meets the gate.

passageOverrides.before: M3-B unit B2-b4a: the T2 discovery census. Re-verifies each lead-readable T2 store against its pinned gitTree and QD-22 digest from stored bytes, no-follow, never opening a held-out entry; checks every modeled walk against the B2-b0 reference population; converts it to objects and edges by an abstract walk mirroring the walker, with unknowns at their dearer branch and constants read by anchors from a whole-pinned cost closure; censuses workspaces as composed checkouts; writes the census record and the soundness vectors.
passageOverrides.after: M3-B units B2-b4a to B2-b4c: the T2 discovery census. Re-verifies each lead-readable T2 store against its pinned gitTree and QD-22 digest from stored bytes, no-follow; checks every modeled walk against the B2-b0 reference population; converts it to objects, edges and bytes (affine in the root spelling length, sizes from a closed inventory) by an abstract walk mirroring the redesigned walker, with unknowns at their dearer branch and constants read by anchors from a whole-pinned cost closure; censuses workspaces as composed checkouts; writes the census record and the soundness vectors. Its --held-out-blind mode (B2-b4 plan r6 section 2.5) measures each held-out store through one guarded join and writes only a closed-format receipt of margins or error classes, bound to its inputs; the ordinary mode never opens a held-out store and composes held-out rows only from a current receipt.
